ios.desc:
Open Instagram without even thinking about it? Clinch puts a small, calming pause between you and the apps that pull at you — so you scroll on purpose, not on reflex.

HOW IT WORKS
• Intercept — the moment you open an app you've chosen, Clinch steps in with a quick moment. Sometimes a breath, sometimes a puzzle or a fact. It changes each time, so it never gets stale.
• Reflect — then it asks one simple question: what brought you here? Stay, or keep going. The choice is yours.
• See your patterns — Clinch shows you when you reach for it the most, and how often you didn't.
• Block the spiral — set time windows where the apps you pick are fully blocked, no bypass.

WHY CLINCH
• A pause that never gets old — different moments, not the same screen every time.
• It asks what a blocker can't: why.
• Nudge it, or wall it off — gentle intercepts and hard schedules, in one app.
• Your data stays on your phone. No account, no cloud.

Inspired by self-nudge research: a brief, calm pause before you open an app — and a real choice — helps loosen the habit over time.

FREE
• 1 app, the core intercept moments, today + this-week stats, and the home-screen widget.

CLINCH PRO
• Unlimited apps and block schedules
• All six intercept moments
• Coach — turns your patterns into one-tap block windows
• Monthly trends and reflections
• Medium and large widgets

Clinch Pro: $1.99/month · $14.99/year (7-day free trial) · $39.99 lifetime.

Break the scroll.

quotes.text:
Hey HN, sharing my new app here - Clinch. I decided to make this app while going through the layoff time at GitLab, though I am safe. During the time, I was bit anxious and offcourse did not have lot of work to do, I doomscroll a lot and hence my mental and phone usage hit badly.

I decided to put this time to work on some side project and came up with the idea to kill my existing pattern.

I tried One Sec, got numb to the same
breath, and wanted something that stayed novel and made me notice the pattern.

When you open an app you've chosen, Clinch steps in with a short (~10–30s)
moment — a breath, a spot-the-dot game, a fact, a finger labyrinth — then asks
one question: "what brought you here?" It rotates through 6 moment types so your
brain can't autopilot through a repeated ritual.

It's been 2 weeks since I published the app and so far got 25 downloads. I realised that distribution is more tougher now.

Sharing to the community here if you wanted to try out and have some suggestion on the app or distribution.

I made a short youtube demo as well: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KvkgxNBRx2g

Thankyou!!!
